newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Petronas to study lubricant project.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Petronas to study lubricant project.

text.p: Malaysian national oil company Petronas said on Wednesday that it had signed a letter of intent with the Chinese Petroleum Corp for a feasibility study on producing base oil for making lubricants.
Petronas said in a statement that the agreement was signed with its joint venture refining company Malaysian Refining Co Sdn Bhd and the Taiwanese state oil firm.
The project would be be built in central Melaka state, Petronas said.
Malaysian Refining, in which Petronas has a 45 percent stake, is involved in the construction, management and operation of the second phase of Petronas' refinery in Melaka.
Other partners of Malaysian Refining, Dupont unit Conoco Asia Ltd with 40 percent and Den Norske Stats Oljeselskap ASA (Statoil) with 15 percent.
